Features
Specifications
Enjoy cinema-quality entertainment with your family anywhere with Alcatel 3T10. A vibrant display boasting an 80% screen-to-body ratio lets you view your favorite media in its full-screen glory whether you’re going to after school activities, visiting relatives, or relaxing at home. For the children in your life, Kids Mode provides screen time that’s safe, educational and fun. Keep your family connected and entertained on the road with 4G LTE streaming and video calling. A 5500mAh battery will keep your tablet powered for your longest days and adventures.
Full-family entertainment
Entertain your family anywhere with Alcatel 3T10's cinematic display. Its bright display with alluring color creates a theater-quality experience that pulls you in no matter what's going on around you. A miniscule 9.96 bezel and maximum display with an 80% screen-to-body ratio give you full-screen viewing to enjoy all your favorite movies, games and more.
Educational fun
Make tablet time fun and fulfilling with Alcatel 3T10's Kids Mode. Its child-friendly interface makes it easy for kids to use without help, while a library of science, technology, engineering, arts and math content will keep them learning and having fun. App non-disturbance controls, web white listing and parental passwords help you oversee your child and keep them safe.
Visual comfort
Keep your eyes comfortable at any time of day with Alcatel 3T10's viewing modes. Eye Care Mode reduces harmful blue light to prevent strain and disruption to your sleep cycle. Adaptive Tone creates the best brightness and tonality for viewing whether you're in bright sunlight or a dark room. Reading Mode provides a grayscale display and adjusts brightness and contrast to your environment for comfortable long reads.
4G connection & calling
Whether you're running errands or going on a family trip, Alcatel 3T10's 4G LTE high-speed wireless network will keep your family connected and entertained no matter how long your journey. A front 5MP camera paired with its fast connection lets you video call your loved ones near or far so you can talk face to face.
Long-lasting battery
Never scramble for an outlet with Alcatel 3T10. A 5500mAh battery with smart power management will help you go all day on a single charge. Reverse charging lets you power your phone or other devices so you never have to shut down. A USB Type-C port makes your tablet easy to charge for people of all ages.

Sit down with your family and watch movies, read books, or play games together thanks to the Acer Iconia Tab P10’s large 10.4” display and 2K (2000 X 1200) resolution. Its thin and light design and long battery life make it easy to use at home or on the road.
Big Screen & High Resolution
Watch movies whenever and wherever you want. This 10.4-inch big screen tablet features 2K (2000 X 1200) resolution and a narrow bezel design that makes it easy to get comfortable and immerse yourself in a movie.
Take it Anywhere
This tablet’s aluminum alloy design keeps it thin and lightweight, measuring 7.8mm thin and weighing 440 grams. In-Cell Touch Panel (iTP) technology also reduces display thickness while improving optical performance.
Built to Perform
This Android 12 tablet lets you watch videos, save pictures, and play games with ease thanks to its MediaTek Kompanio 500 Octa-Core processor, up to 4 GB of memory, 64 GB of eMMC storage, and a MicroSD slot.
All-day Battery
Equipped with a 6,000mAh battery and a USB Type-C port for charging, this tablet gives you up to 10.5 hours of video playback so that you can take this tablet with you anywhere without worrying about running out of power.
Video Calls Made Easy
This tablet features dual-band Wi-Fi and an up to 5MP camera so that your video calls are always crystal clear. The 8MP Auto Focus rear camera also lets you take high-resolution pictures on-the-fly.
Apps for Kids
Google Kids Space gives you and your child a safe place to explore quality content designed to help them learn and keep them engaged. Parents can also help manage the content, screen time, and more with the Family Link app.

Frequently Asked Questions
Which Apple Pencil will work with this iPad?
The Apple Pencil (2nd generation). It pairs wirelessly and attaches magnetically for charging and storage.
What type of SIM does this iPad have?
Newer Wi-Fi + Cellular models include built-in eSIM technology that acts as a digital SIM card. There are a few ways to activate an eSIM on your iPad, including downloading it to the iPad itself, scanning a QR code, or using an app from a carrier.* With eSIM, you can choose cellular data plans from select carriers in more than 180 countries and regions around the world.
Learn more
about setting up eSIM.
Wi-Fi + Cellular models with embedded eSIM technology include iPad Pro 12.9-inch (3rd generation or later), iPad Pro 11-inch (1st generation or later), iPad Air (3rd generation or later), iPad (7th generation or later), and iPad mini (5th and 6th generation).
All Wi-Fi + Cellular models include a nano-SIM tray that supports a carrier SIM card.
More information on iPad support for LTE networks by carrier and country or region
